name: 7-hydroxymitragynine
summary: 7-Hydroxymitragynine (7-OH-MIT), also commonly known simply as 7-OH, is a terpenoid indole alkaloid present in Mitragyna speciosa, the plant from which kratom is derived. It was first described in 1994. In humans, it is produced as an active metabolite of mitragynine via hepatic CYP450 enzymes. 7-OH-MIT exhibits greater binding affinity to μ-opioid receptors (MOR) than mitragynine.

pharmacology.text: 7-OH-MIT, like mitragynine, appears to be a mixed opioid receptor agonist/antagonist, with recent research indicating that it acts as a partial agonist at μ-opioid receptors and as a competitive antagonist at δ- and κ-opioid receptors. It is generated in the liver through the oxidative metabolism of mitragynine, a process predominantly catalyzed by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP3A4, with minor contributions from CYP2C19 and CYP2D6.

uses.text: It is being studied as a potential template for developing opioids with improved safety profiles.
uses.recreational: The alkaloid has been rising in popularity as a recreational drug known as 7-OH, particularly in the United States. 7-OH-MIT containing tablets are sold in an unregulated manner over the counter in gas stations and smoke shops, with little to no information provided to consumers about the risk of addiction or adverse effects.

zhHansOther: 7-羥基帽柱木鹼, 7-羟基丝裂霉素
summaryZh: 7-羥基帽柱木鹼是一種有機化合物，分子式C23H30N2O5，屬於萜類吲哚生物鹼，存在於卡痛樹等植物中。
summaryZhHans: 7-羟基帽柱木碱是一种有机化合物，分子式C23H30N2O5，属于萜类吲哚生物碱，存在于卡痛树等植物中。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils, and it can slow breathing. Concentrated products containing it have been linked to dependence, withdrawal and overdose, with deaths reported.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、噁心、嘔吐、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小，並可能使呼吸變慢。含有它的濃縮製品曾與成癮、戒斷與過量有關，並有死亡報告。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、恶心、呕吐、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小，并可能使呼吸变慢。含有它的浓缩制品曾与成瘾、戒断与过量有关，并有死亡报告。

fact.en: It occurs only in tiny amounts in the kratom leaf, and most of what reaches the body comes from the liver turning mitragynine into it. It was first described in 1994.
fact.zh: 它在卡痛葉中的含量極低，體內大部分的量其實來自肝臟把帽柱木鹼（mitragynine）轉化而成。它於1994年首次被描述。
fact.zhHans: 它在卡痛叶中的含量极低，体内大部分的量其实来自肝脏把帽柱木碱（mitragynine）转化而成。它于1994年首次被描述。
